details.name: MOB.978_DIAG_WorkList_Probe
details.message:
**TEMPORARY DIAGNOSTIC — not coverage. Delete once the row locator is settled.**
- Answers in ONE run why `work_list_gate()`'s row guard found nothing while every
  other readiness check on /work passed.
- Every probe is `optional`, so the test passes and `report` shows which probes failed.
- Distinguishes **a wrong locator** from **an empty crew work list** — they need
  opposite fixes, and no existing test can tell them apart (MOB.340 asserts only the
  search box; MOB.134 only warms the cache).

steps.name: Wait for the SSO login form to hydrate
Wait for the app shell to mount after the env redirect
Open the menu to read the session role
Navigate to /work — the work order list
Let the list load fully (generous — this is a probe)
N>=2  rows  (needed for any SORT-ORDER test)
LEGEND has >=2 distinct statuses (needed for a NEGATIVE filter leg)
LEGEND total == row count (sanity: the ring describes THIS list)
ONE status covers every row (if PASS, no negative filter leg exists)
ROW border colour is readable via getComputedStyle
ROW border colour is the READY green rgb(155, 203, 82)
ROWS have >=2 DISTINCT border colours (a mixed-status list)

values.value: //button[.//*[@data-icon="sort-alt" or @data-icon="arrow-down-arrow-up" or contains(concat(" ", normalize-space(@class), " "), " fa-sort-alt ") or contains(concat(" ", normalize-space(@class), " "), " fa-arrow-down-arrow-up ")]]

steps.name: OPT any option is rendered at all
OPT every option ends with an arrow (so none is a bare 'Collected By Me')
